remarks: Completely renovated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo located in the sought after Silvermine section of Norwalk. An open concept living space meticulously completed with elegant and sophisticated finishes. Beautiful hardwood floors, recess lighting and crown molding throughout the unit. Chef's kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, gas range, and a large pantry. The bedroom has an oversized closet with built-ins and a sliding door leading out to your own private balcony. New modern bathroom has tiled floors, updated vanity and Jacuzzi tub. Stackable laundry conveniently located in unit. 1 car attached garage along with a large storage unit. Central Air and Heat. Well maintained Glenrock complex has an in-ground swimming pool and charming courtyard. Commuters dream - conveniently located 0.2 miles from the newly redone Merritt 7 train station, 0.5 miles from the Merritt and Route 7.
